name: app-3d-glass-chat-panel-with-ribbon-app-icons
title: Frosted chat card tilted in space with translucent rainbow ribbons and app icons
whatItIs: A close-up 3D scene of a translucent blue panel labelled Gemini with a question bubble and long answer card, tilted in perspective, while red, orange and green glass ribbons with small app icons sweep behind it.
whatItMeans: Playful and futuristic; the glassy layers make an AI chat feel like a physical object.
techniques: Render UI cards as thick frosted glass with dotted texture.
Weave translucent ribbons around the interface.
Tilt the panel for dramatic perspective.
Colour the ribbons in a brand palette.
bestFor: AI product motion and launch visuals

vocabulary.definition: A thick translucent card in a 3D scene.
Ribbons that guide the eye through a scene.
A fine dotted pattern on a surface.
Key art for a product announcement.
